sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (uncensored EXL3) — one DGX Spark - GitHub
sources.snippet: A single docker compose up away from serving Qwen3.8-Flash-Next — the uncensored EXL3 re-quant — on an NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10, aarch64), with an OpenAI-compatible API and speculative decoding on. Same workflow as the GLM-5.3-Flash DGX image: get the image, mount the model, talk to it like a cloud model.

sources.snippet: huihui-ai's abliterated Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: the 125B-total, 6B-active MoE with its refusal direction removed, keeping the base model's reasoning (low/medium/xhigh effort) and tool calling. Served by Experiential Cloud on dedicated GPUs. Text only; 262,144-token context, up to 65,536 output tokens.
